scope: M8-OUTPUTS combined native managed main/model-preview workflow; M8-AUDIT remains separate

windows.automation: hidden or minimized with layered alpha zero, nonactivating and input-transparent; no foreground/focus/capture acquisition

capture_protocol: 16 editor-owner actions, render-owner fenced readback and exact frame token acknowledgement before the next action; 28 BMP images
content_phase: after 16 main content warmup frames, hold actor time at 240 ms and pause particles for exact accepted inspection comparisons; main still presents during preview cooks

oracles.main: accepted inspection and props-hidden hashes; resized extent and scene color coverage; exact replay in a second process
oracles.preview: accepted woodbox hash at 640x480, independent original-bounds CPU projection at both extents, exact clear while hidden; main props do not affect shared-asset preview
oracles.clocks: only the minimized view stops presenting; restored views advance; reopened preview starts at presented frame 1
oracles.ownership: one logical device, distinct HWND/surface/swapchain/scene/view/instance/targets; GPU acknowledgement precedes managed preview disposal

shutdown: close preview after another uncaptured paired frame; reopen and hold one scene/view/output resource batch across host WM_CLOSE and render-session close; reject that batch on the editor owner, drain to zero while both HWNDs live, dispose managed bridge after Vulkan teardown
validation: 0 errors / 0 warnings through teardown; preserve accepted images, immutable pack and original inputs
